events.event: GAO published audit of 22 civilian CFO Act agencies' implementation of OMB networked-device inventory requirements and recommended updated OMB guidance and oversight
events.note: OMB did not provide comments; audit recommendations are not sanctions, criminal findings, or proof of a cybersecurity incident.

causality: The reported inventory-control gaps do not establish cyberattack incidence, culpability, citizen service impact, or changes in public trust.
limitations: The 22-agency denominator is not all federal agencies.
Counts of agencies meeting individual requirements overlap and cannot be summed.
The initial inventory deadline was September 2024; observations reflect September 2026 status.
No agency-level causal linkage to service failure or trust is established.
